label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Set it to 4 stars and paste this in:

---

I used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. It was a two-bed flat, though most of the stuff was mine, and the new place is a fourth floor walk-up with no lift, so not an easy job. I'm giving four stars and I'll explain why it's not five, because I read a load of these when I was picking a company and the vague ones were no use to me.

The basics first. I booked through their website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut. The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours, and every other quote I got was €450 or more. The job took about three and a half hours.

The good: the two lads were sound and they worked hard. That's four flights of stairs with a couch and a bed, and neither of them complained once, at least not in front of me. The couch got stuck at the turn on the third floor and I was fairly sure it was going back down again. The younger lad (Kev, I think) pulled an allen key out of his pocket, had the legs off in no time and it went straight in. They also put my bed back together without being asked, and took away a flat pack shelf I didn't want, which saved me working out how to get rid of it. None of that was in the quote.

The not so good: they were booked for 9 and arrived at half 10. In fairness I got a text at 8:40 to say the job before mine had overrun, so I wasn't left wondering. It was still an hour and a half sat on boxes with a cold coffee. For me it wasn't the end of the world. If you have a landlord meeting you for a handover at a set time, though, it would be a real problem. I'd ask for the first job of the day, or leave yourself a good buffer.

The other thing is my brass floor lamp came out of it with a chip in the base. Everything else was wrapped in blankets and arrived perfect, but the lamp went in bare. It was my nanny's, so I was a bit gutted. If you have anything that matters to you, point it out before it goes in the van and make sure it gets wrapped. And lads, wrap the lamps.

On the lateness, Dessie, who runs it, knocked €40 off the bill at the end without me saying a word, so I paid €300 all in. I thought that was decent. Plenty of places would have said nothing and hoped I didn't bring it up.

Would I use them again? Yes. They were the best value I found by a good distance and the work was quick and careful apart from the lamp. When something went wrong, they owned it. Just be clear with them about your timings and tell them what's fragile.

---

It comes to about 470 words. Two things to check before you post:

- **Kev's name:** I kept it as "Kev, I think", so confirm it with Dessie or cut the name.
- **Knowing Dessie:** I left out that you know him from the bar. If you'd rather be upfront, add a line near the top like "I know Dessie to say hello to, but I booked and paid like anyone else."
